ticket.title: CI runner clock skew: retry + infra label in land

history: Your branch makes land.sh wait out a clock step and label a runner-clock failure as infra. The skew came from a new WSL distro on Cara's desktop: WSL distros share one clock, and keep-wsl-up.ps1 starts them. You asked a card whether to add a guard so a new distro can't skew the CI clock again, noting she'd re-run keep-wsl-up.ps1 once to pick it up. Your merge card is still at [the card above](#/p/2/t/900?e=752649). Machines (her desktop's agent) reach Citadel at the address in the README's MACHINES_URL row.
message:
My answers to your question card:

Add a guard so a new WSL distro can't skew the CI clock again? You'd re-run keep-wsl-up.ps1 once to pick it up.
→ Add the guard

facts.why: the real address to put in the command
